tickets.title: Campaign/slot storage split
tickets.description: A campaign owns the immutable forged world; slots are ledger snapshots inside it. Without this, every quicksave writes 300MB.

tickets.title: Deterministic entity ID scheme
tickets.description: hash(worldSeed, poiId, roomIndex, slotIndex) — never spawn order. Prevents the class of bug where loot reappears and dead NPCs return.

tickets.title: Delta storage with default-elision
tickets.description: Only what differs from the forged baseline. Keeps a sixty-hour save under a few megabytes.

tickets.title: Snapshot-plus-tail persistence
tickets.description: Append-only log in memory; last snapshot plus tail on disk; restore and replay on load.

tickets.title: The chronicle: human-readable notable events
tickets.description: Separate from the state ledger. Feeds the journal history view and chronicle export.

tickets.title: Custom compressed binary ledger serialiser
tickets.description: UE reflection-based serialisation is the wrong tool for a few hundred thousand small facts.

tickets.title: Autosave policy: after consequential moments, not before
tickets.description: Reloading should cost real progress. Do not telegraph reload points with popups.

tickets.title: Ironman mode
tickets.description: One rolling save, no manual slots. A flag on the save policy, and the mode where the ledger and Pressure clock finally sing. Offer prominently, never force.

tickets.title: Stable string IDs audit across all content
tickets.description: Never array indices. Adding a catalogue entry must not change what item_47 means.

tickets.title: Save format versioning and migration path
tickets.description: Written before it is needed, not after.

tickets.title: Corruption safety: temp write, fsync, atomic rename, rotating backups
tickets.description: Twenty minutes of work that becomes the only thing anyone remembers if skipped.

tickets.title: Save/load round-trip automated test
tickets.description: Serialise, reload, compare state. The one game-side test worth insisting on.

tickets.title: Audit: no serialised actor pointers to generated actors
tickets.description: Serialise IDs and re-resolve on load; generated actors do not exist when the save is read.

tickets.title: Chronicle export as readable text
tickets.description: 'Here's what happened in my Age of Salt run' — shareable content for the cost of a text serialiser.
